g.text: Held-out simulated stereo–LiDAR fusion: error–coverage tradeoff

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: L = sparse LiDAR; S = SGBM; F = FoundationStereo. Suffix S = simple fusion, A = agreement gate, C = local-SAD-cost gate.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 144 held-out views; 4 geometry groups / 2 independent seed clusters. No confidence intervals or hardware claim.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Abstention can reduce false-free rate. Read coverage and obstacle recall together; sparse LiDAR is not a dense free-space map.
